name: default
description: Starter roster: recon, implementation, prose, review, a second opinion, planning, and external research. Pins no models, because the right model is whatever the user has credentials for: pick per-role models with /pipeline-init, or let every role inherit the session model.

scout.description: Read-only recon: the files, entry points and facts a later step needs, with line evidence. The cheapest role, so others should spawn it for reading.

worker.description: Implements one validated change and validates it.

writer.description: Writes prose for humans — documentation, guides and articles — grounded in sourced facts.

reviewer.description: Independent review of a change against its objective, its tests and its edge cases.

oracle.description: Second opinion on a decision or a stuck problem, without editing anything.

planner.description: Turns findings into a written product or architecture brief and task breakdown; read-only.

researcher.description: Answers one external question from primary sources, with citations.
